construct_or_mutation: initial FtsX ECL1 construct spanning the entire ECL1 domain (topology model: residues 42-182), longer than the 47-168 construct of the assignment
other_conditions: regime (authors): complete chemical exchange broadening of the C-terminal residues; spectra of this construct are not shown; residue types not given
caveat_note: Not the deposited construct (47-168) and no conditions, field or rates stated. The broadening process (conformational exchange, oligomerisation, or other) is not identified.
experiment: 15N-HSQC cross-peak intensities of the longer ECL1 construct (qualitative; field not stated for this construct)
author_claim: The longer construct showed uneven cross peak intensities and complete exchange broadening of C-terminal residues 171-182, next to transmembrane helix 2; this motivated the shorter 47-168 construct.
anchor: An initial construct encompassing the entire ECL1 domain yielded protein characterized by excellent chemical shift dispersion, but uneven cross peak intensities, and complete chemical exchange broadening of C-terminal residues 171–182, proximal to transmembrane helix 2.

construct_or_mutation: FtsX ECL1 Spn, residues 47-168 (plus non-native N-terminal GAMA, numbered 43-46), 15N,13C-labeled
other_conditions: 0.5 to 0.7 mM protein, 10 % v/v D2O; BMRB deposit for this paper is 26534, not the entry's BMRB id
residues_author: gaps in the hNOE plot: N85, Y112, P132, P144
caveat_note: hNOE reports only ps-ns backbone motion; it does not exclude slower exchange. The paper states its assignments were deposited as BMRB 26534, while the entry card lists BMRB 30523 (600/800 MHz, pH 7.0, 298 K), so the card's relationship to this sample is unclear. The authors only speculate on interlobe orientation ('hinge-like' linkage in M. tuberculosis FtsX) and report no measurement of it.
experiment: 15N-{1H} heteronuclear NOE at 600 MHz (single relaxation experiment)
author_claim: hNOE values are generally >= 0.6, supporting the predicted beta-strand and helix segments (beta strands 59-64, 75-77, 81-83, 102-106, 136-141, 162-165; helices 89-95, 108-118, 146-155).
anchor: The predicted secondary structure elements are supported by heteronuclear 15 N–{ 1 H} values that are generally ≥ 0.6
locator: Assignment extension and data deposition; Figure 2B; conditions: NMR spectroscopy; Figure 1 legend
